title: WSInsight CLI schema (QuPath dialog driver)
description: Meta-schema describing the structure of wsinsight-cli-schema.json, which is consumed by the QuPath WSInsight extension to auto-generate dialogs. Purely an editor aid: no runtime validation is performed.

schema_version.description: Bump when a backwards-incompatible change is made to the schema shape.

commands.description: Map of CLI subcommand name -> command definition.

groups.description: UI grouping metadata. Keys are referenced by ParamSpec.group.

flags.description: Click flag(s) for this option. Short flags start with -, long flags with --.

kind.description: Normalised Click type. Drives widget selection in the QuPath dialog.

param_type.description: Click parameter kind. Arguments are positional and ignored by the dialog.

default.description: Default value (any JSON scalar, array, or null).

path_exists.description: Click Path(exists=…). Only meaningful when kind = path/directory.

path_file_okay.description: Click Path(file_okay=…). Only meaningful when kind = path/directory.

path_dir_okay.description: Click Path(dir_okay=…). Only meaningful when kind = path/directory.

choices.description: Required when kind = choice. Populates the ChoiceBox.

group.description: Key of a group declared in the enclosing command's "groups" object.

column_break.description: When true, this main-grid param starts column 2 of the dialog. The first visible param with column_break=true marks the boundary; later breaks are ignored.

render.description: dialog = button opens a modal sub-dialog; inline = rows appended to the main grid.

button_label.description: Label on the button that opens the sub-dialog. Required when render = dialog.

visibleWhen.description: Gating rule: the group or param is shown only when the referenced flag satisfies the condition.

flag.description: Long flag (e.g. --cme) whose current value is examined.

equals.description: Current value must equal this literal.

is_set.description: true = flag has a non-default value; false = flag is unset/default.
